description: Namur - Liste des Voiries officielles is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles. Inventaire des voiries officielles au Registre National sur la commune de Namur. La version cartographique est disponible sur le jeu de données. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Urban planning, Heritage. Its keywords are Voirie, Rue, Localité, Commune, Code rue, RN. The portal shows 1,815 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2023-01-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
